title: fleet text: call the skill byte ratchet by its unit, give two skill files a ceiling row, and drop `bug` from checklist-test's work-label list
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAm8Y73VGNq3PkTe3dc

Filing gate: ③ fleet follow-up with named locations · Source: fleet (left outside #35230 by its reconciliation 7139659486, table at rows "lines" and S5; the parked notes 7027945453 and 7028540539 on #35230). None of these contradicts #35207's rules, so #35230 closes without them.

## What is left

1. **The skill ratchet is still called a line ratchet.** It has counted bytes since PR #35712 (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:5`), but these still say "line":
   - `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:26`, `:32`, `:161`
   - `scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs:62`
   - `scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs:33`, `:1153` (line 28 quotes a ruling verbatim and stays)
   - `.github/workflows/lint.yml:1070` (comment), `:1078` (step name `PM skill line ratchet`); the step id `pm-skill-line-ratchet` at `:1079` is read by nothing else in `scripts/`, `.github/`, `docs/audits/` or `package.json`
   - `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md:245` is a dated census, true when written. Leave it as it is unless the PR shows otherwise.
2. **Two skill files have no ceiling row** in `CEILINGS` (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, from about line 83): `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md` (1,163 bytes) and `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`. Either add the rows at their measured size or say in the PR why the ratchet leaves them out.
3. **`checklist-test` lists `bug` as a work label.** `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md:146` says a `qa-run` record does not carry `bug`/`tests`/`tracking`/priority "work labels". After #35205 a card's kind is its issue type. Check whether `bug` is still a label the fleet writes. If it is not, reword the list so it names only labels that exist.

## Expected

One PR fixes 1–3. Workflow lines are Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`) and go to the seat for approvers. The `.claude/**` lines print MANDATORY, so they are built at the contract-review tier.

Business reason: a gate whose own name and neighbours give the wrong unit makes a reader pay or argue in lines that the gate does not count, and an uncovered file can grow without a ceiling.
Reader who acts: the seat holding area:fleet.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open "line ratchet"` → only #35230 (the parked notes, which this card takes over); `is:issue is:open instrument-discipline ceiling` → 0.
Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none
Grade: area:fleet · Task · wording and coverage with no wrong action today → p3.
